edge.title: Blend weights 60% toward a τ=150 EMA at claim step 2720; stop there
edge.summary: Adds a Tail-EMA readout to #44's otherwise identical training: from step 2000 an EMA with time constant τ=150 steps of every non-embedding parameter is updated after each optimizer step, and at step 2720 the weights are overwritten in place with 0.4·θ + 0.6·EMA immediately before the claim-step validation. STOP_STEP is set to 2720, so the loop ends there while the LR and μ schedules still target 2900 (the claim sits mid-cooldown). Intuition (README): under a decaying LR the late iterates oscillate around the valley floor; a partial blend with a tail average cancels that noise while limiting the EMA's lag bias, with τ ≈ (2900−2720)/1.2.

changes.label: Tail-EMA of weights from step 2000
changes.detail: maybe_update_tail_ema snapshots non-embedding params after update 2000, then lerps the buffer toward θ with weight 1/150 after every optimizer step (keyed step+1).

changes.label: One-shot 0.6 blend at step 2720
changes.detail: At the top of loop step 2720, before validation, every non-embedding param is overwritten via p.lerp_(ema, 0.6), i.e. θ ← 0.4·θ + 0.6·EMA; that validation is the claim.

changes.label: Training stops at 2720
changes.detail: STOP_STEP default 2900→2720: the loop breaks after the step-2720 validation; FINAL_TRAIN_STEPS, PowerCool t_end (2900) and the μ cooldown (2700–2900) are unchanged.

changes.label: Default-off research hooks
changes.detail: Adds env-gated Muon-history forecasting (MUON_HISTORY_STEPS=0 ⇒ apply_muon_history is identity), anchor-readout sweep/apply, TrailDelta pulses, a (τ×λ) Tail-EMA sweep and checkpoint save/resume — all off by default.

edge.parent_check: consistent: c45_p44 is purely additive; with defaults the training trajectory equals #44's up to step 2720 (the EMA is read-only until the blend), so the README's 'byte-identical through step 2000' is conservative.
edge.noise: Default-off scaffolding (Muon-history H5a forecasting, anchor readout sweep/apply, TrailDelta, Tail-EMA sweep, single-GPU checkpoint save/resume), env overrides for FINAL_SCHEDULE_STEPS/MU_COOLDOWN_STEPS with unchanged defaults, extra log lines, _run_val_loss refactor.

mechanisms.name: Tail-EMA blend
mechanisms.explain: After each optimizer step (keyed step+1) the script maintains an EMA of all non-embedding parameters: initialized from the weights after update 2000, then ema ← ema + (θ − ema)/150. At loop step 2720, just before validation, each such parameter is replaced by 0.4·θ + 0.6·ema (p.lerp_(ema, 0.6)); training then stops, so the blended weights are only evaluated. By 2720 the step-2000 initialization retains ≈0.8% weight in the buffer.

caveats: Runs were single-GPU 1×GH200 (world_size=1), n=10 seeds, versus #44's 8×H100; the README notes GH200 val losses ran ~+0.0004 above #44's H100 logs. The blend is destructive, but nothing follows it because the loop stops at 2720. Logs confirm 'tail_ema initialized step:2000' and 'tail_ema applied step:2720', with defaults and no env overrides (run.sh).
